name: Mulled Cider
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Allow six eggs to a quart of cider
Put a handful of whole cloves into the cider, and boil it
While it is boiling, beat the eggs in a large pitcher
Add to them as much sugar as will make the cider very sweet
Pour the boiling liquor on the beaten egg
Continue to pour the mixture backwards and forwards from one pitcher to another, till it has a fine froth on it
Pour it warm into your glasses

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Allow six eggs to a quart of cider
2. Put a handful of whole cloves into the cider, and boil it
3. While it is boiling, beat the eggs in a large pitcher
4. Add to them as much sugar as will make the cider very sweet
5. Pour the boiling liquor on the beaten egg
6. Continue to pour the mixture backwards and forwards from one pitcher to another, till it has a fine froth on it
7. Pour it warm into your glasses
8. Grate some nutmeg over each
